gradle-wrapper.jar is not included in this source package (binary file).

To obtain it, run ONE of:
  1. gradle wrapper --gradle-version 9.3.0   (if Gradle is installed globally)
  2. In IntelliJ IDEA: open the project and it will auto-download the wrapper
  3. Copy gradle-wrapper.jar from any other Gradle 9.x project you have locally

The jar is always available at:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v9.3.0/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Place the downloaded file at:
  gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar
